{{Top|leg}}
'''Shoppingland''' was a major retail outlet in the [[Lola Curich Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Found in the center of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], it was known for having fairly reasonable prices despite the large tourist industry on the planet. It sold a wide range of products, stocking most equipment that any citizen or adventurer could want.
